field.label: Enable DHCP Interface HA
field.help: Enable only after the local interface is configured and all required checks pass. This setting is shared by native XMLRPC configuration sync.

field.label: Managed logical interface
field.help: Select the local OPNsense assignment to manage. Configure interface captures its current device and moves the assignment to the plugin-owned adapter. Choose None to clear this node's plugin mapping while retaining the shared MAC; native assignments are not deleted.

field.label: Shared interface MAC
field.help: This unicast identity is used by the active node and should match on both peers. This setting is shared through XMLRPC configuration sync.
